purpose: Repeatable WebMCP tool-selection and end-to-end journey fixtures
placeholderPolicy: Values in angle brackets must be resolved from earlier inspection results.

fixtures.prompt: Which ArchMorph tool tells me whether every room can be reached from the main entrance?
What is the exact area of Bedroom 2? Do not edit anything.
assertions: Result includes square feet and stable room ID

fixtures.prompt: Make Bedroom 2 exactly 12 feet wide, keeping its current length.
Add an L-shaped office inside the buildable envelope, validate it, and focus the result.
assertions: Area and validation evidence are returned

fixtures.prompt: Create a second floor and a connected straight stair. Verify the stair and room circulation, switch to 3D, and focus the stair.
assertions: Stair identifies source and target floors

fixtures.prompt: After the human moves the living room, inspect the latest project and explain the resulting circulation or setback changes.
assertions: Evidence refers to current stable IDs

fixtures.prompt: Add a window to wall ID wall-does-not-exist.
Place a second door where it overlaps an existing door on the same wall.
assertions: Specific overlap error or validation finding

fixtures.prompt: Present the current design from a useful 3D angle and capture it without downloading a file.
assertions: Snapshot corresponds to current project version
Visible UI matches returned view state

fixtures.prompt: Export the current ArchMorph project as structured JSON without triggering a browser download.
assertions: Result identifies schema and project version
